text: 截至11月11日，中信证券、华泰证券、财通证券已先后召开年度策略会，中信建投证券、浙商证券、开源证券也在密集开讲，六家券商在同一窗口为来年定调。具体来看，AI依旧是市场讨论的核心主线，且多家券商形成共识：AI产业的叙事浪潮尚未落幕，板块中长期仍具备充足的配置空间。展望2027年的A股大盘，对于市场走向，业内观点普遍认为，当前整体已处于估值低位，在流动性边际改善叠加企业业绩修复的双重驱动下，新一轮修复行情正在到来。(北京商报)
text_en: As of November 11, CITIC Securities, Huatai Securities and Caitong Securities have successively held annual strategy meetings, while CSC Financial, Zheshang Securities and Kailuan Securities are also holding a dense schedule of presentations, with six brokerages setting the tone for the coming year in the same window. Specifically, AI remains the core theme of market discussion, and several brokerages have reached a consensus: the narrative wave of the AI industry has not ended, and the sector still has ample allocation space in the medium and long term. Looking ahead to the A-share market in 2027, industry views generally hold that the market as a whole is already at a low valuation level, and driven by both marginal improvement in liquidity and repair of corporate earnings, a new round of recovery is arriving. (Beijing Business Today)
